    }
    option = {
        name = oe_ths.22.b

        name = oe_ths.22.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_ths.22.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -6 } remove_variable = oe_ths_d_pending random_list = { 60 = { c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_overture target = c:BYZ } } set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_bought oe_ths_d_end = { why = 5 } } 40 = { oe_ths_will_add = { n = -10 } } } }

    }
}
